notes: Summary: OceanRidge is a mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood for embeddings-backed semantic search across product docs, onboarding flows and in-app support.
Key ask: ingest ~400k documents, sustain 1500 qps read traffic for search layer, daily batch embed pipeline ~50k docs/day, keep p95/p99 latency < 120ms for top-K rerank.
POC preference: start with Hosted API for speed of integration, then move to Dedicated if costs scale; wanting deterministic pricing for embeddings and burst allowances for spikes.
Quote from CTO: "Need predictable per-query cost — can't have wild token costs during peak analysis windows".
Integration notes: Python backend, async batching via Celery; plan to spike with Pinecone for vector store, evaluate Redwood Dedicated KV caching and direct ANN index performance.
Security: requires SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, audit logs + KMS integration; EU customer data must remain in EU region for residency customers.
Ops ask: resumable nightly batch job with checkpoints and partial-retry semantics; clear instrumentation for cost and latency per-run.
Business constraints: procurement window closes mid-May; champion (VP Product) pushing for Redwood due to runtime optimizations demonstrated in demo.
Pricing sensitivity: mid-market budget — target ARR commit $60k-$120k first year but prefers optional burst credits and predictable unit pricing.
Demo notes: engineering liked token-level cost breakdowns, streaming and function calling; curious about Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization.
